explanation: Refused: W = 1.45 GeV is below the eta electroproduction threshold (1.4861 GeV for e p -> e' p eta). The final state cannot be on-shell. Additionally, W = 1.45 lies outside the lookup-table grid [1.4856, 6.0000], so the Fortran would have to extrapolate the hadronic model. Per the preflight guidance, this is unphysical — not a formatting error — so shifting W would not be a legitimate fix. A valid eta grid starts at W >= 1.4961 GeV. No input files were generated.
